name: Atlantis Submarines Barbados
summary: Atlantis Submarines Barbados runs passenger submarine tours from the Shallow Draught in Bridgetown, diving up to 150 feet past coral reef and the Lord Willoughby shipwreck. Guests stay dry in an air-conditioned cabin with large viewports while the co-pilot narrates. Day and night dives run on the same battery powered submarine, which carries up to 48 guests.
standouts: Battery powered submarine that dives to 150 feet
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in

contact.address: P.O. Box 394, The Shallow Draught, Bridgetown, BB 11142, Barbados

trips.title: Submarine Day Dive
trips.summary: A daytime submarine tour from Bridgetown that descends up to 150 feet to see coral reef, tropical fish and the Lord Willoughby shipwreck. A shuttle boat takes guests out to the submarine, where they sit in an air-conditioned cabin facing large viewports. No swimming is needed.
highlights: Views the Lord Willoughby shipwreck at 120 feet
trips.duration: Approximately 1 hour and 45 minutes (40-45 minutes spent entirely underwater)

trips.title: Submarine Night Dive
trips.summary: An evening submarine tour that starts around sunset, when the submarine's lights show the reef's colour and night creatures such as lobsters, eels and lionfish. It dives up to 150 feet off the west coast and spends about 45 minutes underwater.
highlights: Lit by the submarine's LED floodlights
Night creatures such as eels, lobsters and lionfish
Runs on designated nights, timed to sunset
trips.duration: Approximately 2 hours in total, including a 45-minute underwater tour

trips.title: Down & Under Cave Combo
trips.summary: A one-day package pairing the Atlantis submarine dive with a guided electric tram tour of Harrison's Cave in the centre of the island. RCR Tours drives guests from the submarine to the cave.
highlights: Transfer to Harrison's Cave by RCR Tours
Guided electric tram ride through Harrison's Cave
includes: Transport from the submarine to Harrison's Cave
Guided electric tram tour of Harrison's Cave
trips.checkNotes: Booked by email: the page's button is 'Email Us' (contact page) and the combo is commented out of the online reservation page. Child age range for this fare not stated.

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Groups can charter the submarine for a private standard expedition tour for up to 48 guests. Other group options are Tea Under the High Seas, a Five Star Champagne Tour for up to 22 guests, and Sushi Under the Sea, with sushi served in bento boxes during the dive.
highlights: Five Star Champagne Tour, 22 guests max
Sushi Under the Sea, 12 person minimum payment

checkNotes: Still trading: the home page shows an October 2026 deal and 2026 promo codes, and the video gallery has a 2026 video. The home page code contains a hidden pop-up saying 'We are temporarily closed in order to complete our annual re-certification', but its trigger is commented out, so it is not shown. Own booking engine at /reservation (choose a date, then check out); cruise ship guests are sent to their cruise line's shore excursion pages. A government levy is added to tickets. After-hours number +1 (246) 243-1069 (also the WhatsApp number). The FAQs say the submarine carries a maximum of 48 guests.
